provider.name: Linear
provider.identityReason: Linear is a modern issue tracking and project management platform. The identity resolves unambiguously to linear.app.

managedOption.details: Composio does not publicly document a managed OAuth option for Linear on their integration catalog or provider documentation. Developer must verify directly with Composio support or check their latest API connections list.

setup: Confirmed: Linear requires OAuth 2.0 registration at https://linear.app/settings/api-keys (team admin access required).
Confirmed: Registration requires creating an OAuth application with client ID and client secret generation.
Confirmed: Redirect URI must be specified during app registration and must match exactly during authorization flow.
Confirmed: Linear OAuth endpoint is https://linear.app/oauth/authorize for authorization and https://linear.app/oauth/token for token exchange.
scopeFindings: Confirmed: Linear uses scope-based permissions. Official scopes include: read, write, delete, and admin.
Confirmed: Scopes are combined as space-separated strings (e.g., 'read write' for read and write permissions).
Confirmed: read scope permits viewing issues, projects, and team data; write enables creating and updating; admin grants organizational-level access.
Estimate: Exact granular scope list (e.g., 'issues:read', 'projects:write') is not explicitly documented in public OAuth reference; Linear uses broader scope categories.
testAndLaunch: Confirmed: Linear provides a personal API key testing mechanism at https://linear.app/settings/api-keys for non-OAuth development.
Unknown: Whether Linear offers a separate test/sandbox OAuth environment or if testing uses production OAuth credentials.
Confirmed: OAuth applications must be created by team admin; test users are regular team members invited to the workspace.
Unknown: Published timeline for OAuth app review or approval before production use; Linear may auto-approve or require manual review.
review: Confirmed: Linear requires team admin authorization to create an OAuth application.
Unknown: Whether Linear performs security review or verification of OAuth applications before granting production access.
Unknown: Whether customer/workspace admin approval is required after initial app registration.
Estimate: Review and verification process (if any) timeline is not published in official documentation.
support: Confirmed: Linear provides developer documentation at https://developers.linear.app with API and OAuth references.
Confirmed: Support available via Linear support portal at https://linear.app/help and community Slack.
Confirmed: OAuth-specific issues can be reported through Linear's support channels; escalation path for OAuth registration problems exists but detailed recovery steps are not published.
result.nextAction: Register a Linear OAuth application at https://linear.app/settings/api-keys using team admin credentials, capture the client ID and secret, configure your redirect URI, and test authorization flow with a team member account. Contact Linear support (https://linear.app/help) to confirm whether OAuth review is automatic or requires explicit approval. Verify current Composio Linear integration status by checking https://composio.dev or requesting support if managed OAuth is needed.
